subject: Proposal: consolidate monthly billing to annual upfront (options & payment flex)
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@cleardata.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@cleardata.io>, finance@cleardata.io
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Looking to move ClearData to annual prepay — numbers & asks

Hi Jonas,

We had an internal review and would like to explore consolidating our current monthly/quarterly billing into a single annual prepay for 2027. Before we commit, finance needs:

- A clear proposal showing (a) term discounts for 1yr vs 2yr, (b) suggested ramp/true-up cadence, and (c) payment-term options (Net30/Net45/Net60).
- Any onboarding or early-termination concessions you typically include.
- A sense of how usage credits would work if we commit to, say, 75% of our last 12mo run-rate.

Attached is our Q3 usage export for context (usage_report_q3.csv). We have legal and finance on standby — Sam (cc) will coordinate procurement and contract review.

Can you send a short options matrix and a recommended path (we're leaning conservative: limit downside if we overshoot early months). Happy to jump on a 30-minute call next week.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Clarke
CFO, ClearData
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@cleardata.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@cleardata.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Looking to move ClearData to annual prepay — numbers & asks

Hi Emma — thanks for the context and the file.

Short answer: we can do an annual prepay with a few standard patterns; I'll summarize three paths below and we can pick one on a call. Attached: prepay_options_summary.pdf for a one-pager.

Option A — Single-year prepay (simple)
- Commit: 100% of agreed annual $ (invoiced upfront)
- Discount: 15% off list for 1yr upfront
- True-up: annual true-up at year-end; no staged credits
- Payment: Net30 (can move to Net45 with finance approval)

Option B — 1yr staged ramp (lower risk for customer)
- Commit: 75% of 12mo trailing run-rate, invoiced upfront
- Discount: 18% listed; plus 3% promotional credit applied to first quarter if actual usage < commit
- True-up: 6-month checkpoint for one-time true-up adjustment
- Payment: Upfront invoice, Net45 allowed

Option C — 2yr reserve (best price / predictable for Redwood)
- Commit: 200% over 2 years (billed annually or upfront)
- Discount: 25% off list for 2yr prepay
- True-up: annual true-up, 60-day notice for material changes
- Payment: annual invoice with Net30 preferred

Other notes: we can include a 90-day onboarding credit for ramp-sensitive workloads (one-time). We'll also surface an early-termination pro-rated refund schedule.

If helpful, Marissa and Ben are on this thread to talk through commercial flex (discount bands, promotional credits). Does Tuesday 11/2 or Wednesday 11/3 at 10am PST work for a 30-min sync?

Best,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal — ClearData prepay negotiation (numbers to approve)

Marissa / Ben — follow-up from Emma's ask. Summary of recommended commercial posture for CLD-2026-11-07:

Summary ask from customer:
- Move from monthly/quarterly to annual upfront (wants low downside in early months).
- Prefers staged ramp and flexible true-up (wants 75% safety commit option).

Our recommended package to offer (we discussed on call):
- Primary offer: Option B (1yr staged ramp) as the customer asked — gives them downside protection and keeps Redwood upside.
  * Pricing: 18% discount on list for 1yr, plus a one-time promotional credit equal to 3% of annual invoice applied against Q1 if usage < commit.
  * Ramp: first 3 months have a built-in consumption buffer: we waive overage billing up to 10% over monthly baseline (one-time), then standard per-token pricing thereafter.
  * True-up: 6-month checkpoint; final true-up at year-end.
  * Payment: invoice upfront; allow Net45 as a concession for finance.

- Stretch offer (if they push): 2yr at 24% discount, invoice annually, with Net30 required.

Margin & risk notes:
- Margin impact: the 3% promo + 10% initial buffer reduces gross margin on year1 by ~2.1 pts (see margin_impact_model.xlsx). Ben, confirm this aligns with finance guardrails.
- We should require SSO + SOC2 attestation as standard; legal to keep early-termination pro-rata refund but with 90-day notice.

Approvals requested:
- Marissa: confirm discount band (18% vs 20% flat).
- Ben: approve Net45 concession and promo credit; confirm margin tolerance.
- Lauren: any legal must-haves we should pre-clear before sending final proposal?

If we can approve by EOD 11/2 I will send the customer the formal written proposal and attach a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Jonas

Subject: Final proposal — 1yr staged annual prepay (ClearData)

Hi Emma / Sam — following our internal approvals, please find the formal proposal below. This is intentionally concise so procurement/legal can move quickly.

Agreed commercial terms (Option B — Finalized):
- Commitment: 75% of trailing 12-month run-rate, invoiced upfront for the 12-month term (we've applied the 18% discount).
- Discount: 18% off list price for Year 1.
- Ramp protections: first 3 months — 100% usage buffer on up to 10% over your monthly baseline. If you exceed the buffer, normal per-token pricing applies.
- Promotional credit: 3% of annual invoice applied to Q1 billing if usage is below the commit threshold.
- True-up cadence: 6-month checkpoint and year-end final true-up.
- Payment terms: upfront invoice issued upon signature; finance has agreed Net45 as requested.
- Early termination: pro-rated refund on unused prepaid funds after 90-day notice and administrative fee (standard).

Attachments: proposed_mop_slip.docx (commercial summary) and the margin model we used for internal review.

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, sign via the DocuSign link below and we'll generate the upfront invoice.
   https://docusign.com/tx/ABCD-1234
2) Finance will provision Net45 on the invoice; accounting@redwood.com will be cc'd on the DocuSign envelope.
3) We'll schedule a 30-min onboarding call to align on usage reporting, tagging, and the 6-month checkpoint.

If you'd like a small additional concession to close this week, we can offer a one-time 2% pay-in-advance rebate (applied on receipt of funds within 14 days of invoice). Let me know if you want that added.

Best regards,
